privacy.title: Privacy Policy

section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.paragraph1: ARBINOTE (hereinafter "we", "our", "the platform") is committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our referee rating platform.
section1.paragraph2: By using ARBINOTE, you agree to the practices described in this policy. If you do not agree to these practices, please do not use our service.

section2.title: 2. Data Collected
section2.paragraph1: We collect the following types of data when you use ARBINOTE:

list.item1: Device Identifier (Device Fingerprint): We use FingerprintJS to generate a unique identifier based on the technical characteristics of your device (browser, operating system, screen resolution, etc.). This identifier is used solely to prevent multiple votes and ensure the integrity of the rating process.
list.item2: Voting Data: When you vote for a referee, we record your evaluation (scores by criterion, overall rating), the match identifier, the referee identifier, and your device identifier.
list.item3: User Preferences: We store your language preferences (French, English, Arabic) and theme preferences (light/dark mode) in your browser via localStorage and cookies.
list.item4: Active League: We store your active league selection in a cookie to improve your browsing experience.
list.item5: Browsing Data: We automatically collect certain technical information such as your IP address, browser type, operating system, and pages visited to ensure the proper functioning of the platform.

section2.paragraph2: Important: We do not collect personally identifiable data such as your name, email address, phone number, or postal address.

section3.title: 3. Cookies and Similar Technologies
section3.paragraph1: We use the following technologies to improve your experience:

list.item1: Essential Cookies: "arbinote-locale" (language preference), "activeLeagueId" (selected league). These cookies are necessary for the platform to function.
list.item2: LocalStorage: We store your theme preferences ("arbinote-theme"), language preference ("arbinote-locale"), and a local list of your votes ("note-arbitre-votes") to improve performance and your experience.
list.item3: You can manage or delete these cookies and data through your browser settings. However, this may affect some platform features.

section4.title: 4. Use of FingerprintJS
section4.paragraph1: ARBINOTE uses FingerprintJS (version 5.0.1), a third-party service that generates a unique identifier based on your device and browser characteristics. This technology is used exclusively to:
section4.paragraph2: Prevent Multiple Votes: Ensure that only one vote per match is recorded per device, thus preserving the integrity of statistics and rankings.

note.title: Important Note:
note.text: The identifier generated by FingerprintJS is not personally identifiable and cannot be used to identify you outside of the ARBINOTE platform. We do not share this identifier with third parties for advertising or tracking purposes.

section5.title: 5. Use of Data
section5.paragraph1: We use your data for the following purposes:

list.item1: Platform Operation: Manage the voting system, calculate statistics and rankings, and display results.
list.item2: Experience Improvement: Remember your preferences (language, theme, league), personalize the display, and facilitate your navigation.
list.item3: Security and Integrity: Detect and prevent fraud, multiple votes, and abuse to maintain the quality and reliability of data.

section6.title: 6. Data Sharing and Disclosure
section6.paragraph1: We are committed to not selling, renting, or sharing your data with third parties for commercial purposes. However, we may share certain information in the following cases:
section6.paragraph2: Anonymized Aggregated Data: Overall statistics (averages, rankings, trends) are public and accessible to all users. This data is anonymized and does not allow individual identification.

list.item1: Service Providers: We may use third-party services (hosting, database) that have access to the technical data necessary for the platform to function. These providers are required to respect data confidentiality and security.
list.item2: Legal Obligations: If required by law, we may disclose your information to competent authorities.
list.item3: Protection of Our Rights: We may reveal information if necessary to protect our rights, property, or the security of our users.
list.item4: With Your Consent: In any other case, we will only share your data with your explicit consent.

section7.title: 7. Data Security
section7.paragraph1: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your data:

list.item1: Encryption: Communications between your browser and our servers are encrypted via HTTPS.
list.item2: Secure Database: Your data is stored in a secure MySQL database with restricted access.
list.item3: Access Limitation: Only authorized administrators have access to data to ensure maintenance and technical support.

section8.title: 8. Your Rights
section8.paragraph1: In accordance with data protection laws (GDPR for EU residents), you have the following rights:
section8.paragraph2: Right of Access: You can request a copy of the data we hold about you. However, since we do not collect personally identifiable data, this access will be limited to technical data (device identifier, associated votes).
section8.paragraph3: Right to Deletion: You can request the deletion of your votes. Note that deleting a vote may affect already calculated statistics and rankings.

section9.title: 9. Data Retention Period
section9.paragraph1: We retain your data for the following periods:
section9.paragraph2: Votes: Your votes are retained indefinitely to maintain the history of statistics and rankings. However, you can request their deletion at any time.

section10.title: 10. Contact
section10.paragraph1: For any questions regarding this privacy policy or to exercise your rights, you can contact us:
section10.paragraph2: We are committed to responding to your requests as soon as possible.

contact.title: Contact:

section11.title: 11. Policy Changes
section11.paragraph1: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. Significant changes will be communicated to you via a notification on the platform.
section11.paragraph2: We encourage you to regularly consult this page to stay informed of our data protection practices.

privacy.footer: By continuing to use ARBINOTE, you accept this privacy policy. If you do not accept these terms, please stop using our service.

list.item2: Vote and rate referees on different criteria (main referee, VAR, assistants)

section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.paragraph1: ARBINOTE uses technical cookies to ensure the proper functioning of the platform and improve your browsing experience. This page informs you about the use of cookies on our website.

item2.name: activeLeagueId

section3.title: 3. Purposes of Use

section4.paragraph2: Loss of your language and theme preferences, the need to re-select your active league on each visit, or the inability to vote if the device fingerprint is deleted.

credibility.tooltip: Vote credibility: {{percentage}}% - Based on statistical analysis of votes to detect manipulation

modal.title: What is credibility?
modal.description: The credibility score measures the reliability of a match's votes by analyzing voting patterns to detect potential manipulation.

high.title: High credibility (80-100%)
high.description: Votes appear authentic and diverse. No suspicious patterns detected.

medium.title: Medium credibility (60-79%)
medium.description: Votes are generally reliable, but some minor anomalies have been detected.

low.title: Low credibility (40-59%)
low.description: Significant anomalies have been detected in voting patterns. Reliability is reduced.

veryLow.title: Very low credibility (0-39%)
veryLow.description: Major anomalies have been detected. Votes may be manipulated or coordinated.

modal.howItWorksText: Our system analyzes votes in real-time to detect: grouped extreme votes, coordinated votes, identical votes and rushed votes. The higher the score, the more reliable the votes.

header.title: Our commitment to reliable ratings
header.description: Discover how Arbinote protects the integrity of evaluations and ensures fair results.

intro.title: Why is this important?
intro.text: On the internet, some may attempt to manipulate ratings by voting multiple times or organizing coordinated voting campaigns. We have implemented multiple levels of protection to ensure that each rating truly reflects the community's opinion.

bayesian.title: Smart average (Bayesian)
bayesian.description: Instead of a simple average, we use an advanced statistical formula. A referee with only 2 votes of 5/5 will not automatically get the best rating.
bayesian.howItWorksText: Ratings are weighted by the number of votes. The more votes a referee accumulates, the more representative their rating becomes of general opinion.

anomalies.title: Automatic anomaly detection
anomalies.description: Our system analyzes voting patterns in real-time and detects suspicious behavior.

extreme.title: Grouped extreme votes
extreme.description: Too many 5/5 or 1/5 at the same time

coordinated.title: Coordinated votes
coordinated.description: Many votes in a few minutes

identical.title: Identical votes
identical.description: All votes with the exact same rating

rushed.title: Rushed votes
rushed.description: Votes too fast after the match

weighting.title: Smart vote weighting
weighting.description: Rather than deleting votes, we adjust their influence. A suspicious vote counts less in the final calculation, but is not erased.
weighting.exampleText: A vote very far from the average of other votes will have less impact. A moderate and thoughtful vote will have more weight.

protection.title: Protection against multiple votes
protection.description: Each device can only vote once per match. We use several techniques to identify multiple voting attempts.
protection.speedDetection: Detection of votes that are too fast

moderation.title: Human surveillance
moderation.description: Our moderation team receives automatic alerts in case of suspicious behavior and can intervene manually if necessary.
moderation.alertsText: When a match shows anomalies, our moderators are immediately notified to examine the situation.

credibility.title: Credibility score
credibility.description: Each match receives a credibility score (0-100%) based on the analysis of its votes. A high score indicates that votes appear authentic and diverse.

footer.title: Questions?
footer.description: If you have questions about our system or notice suspicious behavior, please do not hesitate to contact us.
